title: English comprehension/paraphrase pilot: synthetic training candidates v3
status: TRAINING ONLY — v3 candidate set for independent delta rereview; not checked training data, not evaluation data, and not a frozen run contract

v1_preservation.instruction: v1 is preserved unchanged; v2 is a new file.

design_note: Both pilot arms use identical comprehension questions. One arm freely generates the original source; the other freely generates its meaning-preserving paraphrase.

family_scope.unambiguous_descriptive_reference: Four reference-resolution candidates include plausible same-type competitors and an unambiguous distinguishing description or relation.
family_scope.two_simple_relations_combined: These are labeled two-relation fact-binding examples; they make NO multi-hop composition claim.

free_answer_policy.response_type: short free answers; each question has a canonical answer and an explicit item-specific accepted_answers list
normalization: normalize curly and straight apostrophes to the same form
trim outer whitespace and terminal punctuation
free_answer_policy.acceptance: After only those mechanical normalizations, accept an answer only if it matches one of that question's listed accepted_answers. Do not infer synonyms, drop distinguishing attributes, or use an LLM/hidden semantic judge. Add any desired safe variant explicitly before scored use.
free_answer_policy.yes_no: For yes_no questions, the only accepted normalized answers are yes or no exactly as listed.
free_answer_policy.disambiguation: For questions where competing entities share a noun head, require the identifying attribute or relation shown in the accepted_answers; do not accept a bare head noun.
free_answer_policy.status: Provisional answer key for independent rereview; aliases are explicit candidates, not proof the set is exhaustive.

all_fact_review_instruction: Independently compare every all_asserted_facts entry against BOTH source_text and paraphrase. Check actor, event, negation, comparison direction, event order, exact temporal/spatial scope, manner, entity attributes, and what is not asserted. The two comprehension questions do not replace proposition-by-proposition review.
learner_input_boundary: For any later pilot input assembly, expose only source_text or paraphrase and the identical question strings; keep IDs, family, facts, answers, aliases, and review metadata out of learner input.
